title: plain-explain content model
description: Lens-neutral, diagram-first explanation: boxes, short numbered arrows, optional compact steps, and a short closing. See MODEL.md.

goal.description: One sentence under the picture, on every lens. Write it in words every lens allows.

audience.description: Default lens id when render is called without --lens.

audiences.description: Allowed terms per audience name or lens id. No glossary entry required. --audience selects an extra key; the lens id and all always apply.

allowed_terms.description: Extra allowed terms for every lens, with no glossary entry.

direction.description: Default flowchart direction. A lens may override it.

legend.description: Optional short line drawn as a Mermaid note node (for dashed = optional or failure).

steps.description: Numbered 1..n, contiguous in the full model. A lens keeps steps whose level equals its max_level, then renumbers them onto arrow labels. Shown as a list only when the lens has show_steps.

skipped.description: Prefer a dashed arrow instead. Shown as a section only when the lens has show_skipped.

risks.description: What can go wrong. At most three short bullets. Used when closing_section.field is 'risks'.

user_impact.description: User-facing impact. At most three short bullets. Used when closing_section.field is 'user_impact'.

tradeoffs.description: Tradeoffs and failure points. At most three short bullets. Used when closing_section.field is 'tradeoffs'.

glossary.description: Term to one-line definition. Terms become allowed for the vocabulary check. Shown only when the lens has show_glossary.

details.description: Optional extra detail, shown last, and only when the lens has show_details. Usually off.

visibility.description: Legacy. Prefer level, collapse_to, and aggregate. always: every lens. internal: only when show_internals. external: only when show_internals is false.

id.description: Stable id, also the Mermaid node id.

level.description: 1 = everyone (product), 2 = tech-lead aggregates, 3 = engineer detail. Default 1.

collapse_to.description: Id of a coarser parent box. When that parent is visible, this box is hidden and arrows are rewritten through the parent.

aggregate.description: If true, shown only when the lens has collapse: true (a coarse parent such as Client or Storage).

group.description: Mermaid subgraph title. Adjacent boxes with the same group are wrapped together.

note.description: Optional short annotation drawn in parentheses on the box.

shape.description: Default box. decision draws a diamond; note a stadium; round a rounded rectangle.

internal.description: If true, shorthand for visibility: internal. Ignored when visibility is set. Prefer level and collapse_to.

label.description: Short text on the arrow. action is what is drawn when set.

actor.description: Who acts. A concrete actor, such as the visitor's browser or the site owner.

action.description: What they do, at most five words, such as GET /about or HTML coming back. Drawn on the arrow.

step.description: Optional author hint of a primary step. Visible numbering comes from the lens-filtered, renumbered steps, not this field.

kind.description: normal is a solid hop. optional and failure are dashed. query may start a new phase (the map asking). branch is an alternate path.

style.description: Override. optional and failure are dashed even if this is omitted.

n.description: 1-based order in the full model. Must be contiguous in the full list.

text.description: One short line. Shown only when the lens has show_steps.

arrow.description: Id of the arrow this step describes. Used to put the renumbered step on that arrow's label.

level.description: Kept when equal to the lens max_level. Default 1.

definition.description: One line, using only allowed terms, other glossary terms, or common words.
